# Vendored rule files

Downloaded by the project owner on 2026-09-30 into `download-packages/`, which is kept local
and git-ignored. The files the app uses are extracted into `vendor/`. Hashes are SHA-256 of the
original zips, so anyone can re-download and verify them.

| Package | Version | Source | SHA-256 | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ro16931-ubl-1.0.9.zip | CIUS-RO Schematron 1.0.9 (RO_CIUS 1.0.1, embeds EN 16931 rules) | https://mfinante.gov.ro/static/10/eFactura/ | 818e7dd77e429f5dbde7c60b43dddbdf1a9a82a1773c359caa80a36ef89ea7f2 | EUPL 1.2 |
| en16931-ubl-1.3.16.zip | EN 16931 validation artefacts 1.3.16 (2026-04-10), cross-check only | https://github.com/ConnectingEurope/eInvoicing-EN16931/releases/tag/validation-1.3.16 | bafada015efbc5248bf5e05ad2191e1d9833ef96e9dd5f4bce420a747342da85 | EUPL 1.2 |
| en16931-cii-1.3.16.zip | Same, CII syntax. Not used | same | 1cd53cb8a84d38aedc82c0caede217da983a7934dd663f793a092fd66443c561 | EUPL 1.2 |
| UBL-2.1.zip | OASIS UBL 2.1 | https://docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/os-UBL-2.1/UBL-2.1.zip | 60b80d76394a8a2add90723ecb8e0e2e9d826775de9749df37a72d60703f86ed | OASIS |

## Layout
- `vendor/anaf/ro16931-ubl-1.0.9/`: Schematron source. Entry point `EN16931-CIUS_RO-UBL-validation.sch`.
  The package's old `preprocessed/` files (v1.0.5, v1.0.8) were not used.
- `vendor/anaf/compiled/ro16931-ubl-1.0.9.xslt`: generated by `scripts/build_schematron.py`.
  The script patches the ISO skeleton output so rules also visit attributes. Without the patch,
  attribute-context rules (`BR-CL-03` on `//@currencyID`, `BR-CL-23` on `//@unitCode`) never
  fire, which ANAF's own validator showed.
- `vendor/ubl-2.1/xsd/`: `maindoc/` Invoice and CreditNote plus `common/`.
- `vendor/iso-schematron/`: ISO Schematron compiler XSLT from
  https://github.com/Schematron/schematron (MIT license), used only to compile the rules.
- `vendor/en16931-1.3.16/`: precompiled EN 16931 XSLT, not used at runtime.

## Cross-check with ANAF's offline validator (kept local, not in git)
These ANAF downloads are too large for GitHub and stay in the owner's local
`download-packages/` (git-ignored):

| Package | What it is | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| roefacturavalidator_12122024.zip | ANAF offline validator 1.3.0 (Java, bundles JRE 11) | Oracle for `scripts/compare_with_anaf.py` |
| exemple_Invoice_CreditNote.zip | ANAF sample invoice and credit note | Sanity check |
| eFactura_CII_exempleXML.zip | ANAF CII examples | Not used (we validate UBL only) |
| verifstandalone.zip | Verifies the signature on ANAF response files | Out of scope (no live submission) |
| GenerareFactura(All).zip | ANAF XML-to-PDF invoice viewer (Java) | Possibly Milestone 5, for synthetic PDFs |

Findings (2026-10-01):
- The validator bundles the same `ro16931-ubl-1.0.9` rules as ours (identical apart from line
  endings). So 1.0.9 is still current as of ANAF's December 2024 validator.
- Its change log: 1.3.0 (12.12.2024) allows CNP = 13 zeros for B2C buyers.
- ANAF's two sample files are outdated: they declare `CIUS-RO:1.0.0`, so both the official tool
  and ours reject them with `BR-RO-001`. The sample's CIFs are placeholders.
- Buyer and seller identifier checks run outside the Schematron. We reproduced them by probing
  (see `facturaguard/validation/identifiers.py` and `tests/test_identifiers.py`).
- After the fixes, `scripts/compare_with_anaf.py` gives the same verdict on 100/100 synthetic
  invoices, and every ANAF finding is also in ours. ANAF stops at the first failing stage
  (XML/XSD, then Schematron, then identifiers); we report all stages.

## Open question
How should an EU business buyer (no Romanian CUI) be identified? ANAF's validator rejects a buyer
identified only by a foreign VAT id. Thirteen zeros in BT-47 pass the tool, but ANAF documents
that for B2C. Needs an accountant's answer.
